image_description: The image displays two small, stocky marsupials, identified as wombats, perched on a light-colored ledge or wall. The foreground features a patterned fabric surface. The animals have coarse, dark grey/brown fur, broad blunt heads, small eyes, and rounded ears. Their bodies are barrel-shaped and low to the ground. The animal in the background has a visible, albeit short, tail. The lighting is somewhat dim, and the image quality suggests it might be an older photograph or a lower-resolution capture.
